title: Call Centre Agent
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Full-time role - 37.5 Hours per week

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
JOB TITLE: Customer Service Advisor

PAY: 14.40p/hr

LOCATION: Cardiff City Centre - John Street

HOURS: Full Time, 35 hours per week

WORKING PATTERN:

Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least 2 days per week, or 40% of our time, in our office in Cardiff. We'll just need your commitment to 35 hours across Mon-Fri (8.30am-6pm) and weekend working, Sat 9-5 and Sun 11-4pm on a rotational basis. The first 3 months will be 100% office based.

START DATE: 16th November

CONTRACT: 12 months

About this opportunity

Our Customer Service teams are the heartbeat of our organisation. Do you want to be part of a team that makes a genuine difference to our transport customers?

Consumer Lending is a key part of our Group and helps customers by providing cars, vans, caravans, and motorbikes and/or the finance for them.

We're currently looking for people who care about customers to join our contact centre teams supporting our Black Horse brand.

As a Transport Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact to new and existing customers. Applying your skills and expertise to help them with their financial & service needs via a range of channels. You'll build relationships with our customers on every call you take, and by listening carefully and asking the right questions, you'll identify and promote the best possible outcome.

Day to day, you'll be:
- Delivering outstanding customer experiences through various communication channels.
- Supporting our customers through phone-based interactions
- Problem-solving, being creative with solutions and pay excellent attention to the details.
- Playing a role in educating our customers about our products.
- Pro-active in your approach to personal development and learning.

Why Lloyds Banking Group?

Join us and, as well as making a difference to customers, you'll enjoy a fulfilling career where you're free to be yourself. Great colleagues, transforming workspaces, hybrid working and a wide variety of career opportunities - you'll find them all here.

What you'll need
- Solid communication and listening skills including a friendly telephone manner.
- Experience in a phone-based role
- Honest, hardworking, and genuine. Caring about helping people with their queries.
- The empathy to put yourself in the customers' shoes, asking the questions needed to understand how we can help.
- The commitment to deliver on your promises and go above and beyond for people.
- You will need to be competent in using Microsoft applications.

Ideally, we would like you to have previous customer service experience from a motor / financial services background, but this isn't essential.

About working for us

Our focus is to ensure we're inclusive every day and build an organisation that reflects modern society and celebrates diversity in all its forms.

We want our people to feel that they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer initiative.

And it's why we especially welcome applications from under-represented groups.

We're disability confident. So, if you'd like reasonable adjustments to be made to our recruitment processes, just let us know.

If you're excited by the thought of becoming part of our team, get in touch.

We'd love to hear from you!

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant Cardiff Hybrid

Are you an ambitious Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant looking for a role where you can genuinely make an impact?

We're working with a fast-paced, internationally focused SME based in Cardiff that is restructuring its finance function and looking for a Finance Assistant to join the team at an exciting time of growth and development.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on, organised and involved across a broad range of finance activities, rather than being restricted to one area.

The Role

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, ensuring everything runs smoothly and accurately while supporting month-end, reporting and wider business processes.

You'll be trusted to manage your workload independently, with support and training from the Financial Controller.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the finance inbox and responding to internal and external queries
- Processing purchase invoices and preparing supplier payments
- Raising sales invoices and maintaining billing schedules
- Chasing outstanding payments and supporting credit control
- Completing bank reconciliations across multiple accounts
- Processing employee expenses
- Preparing payroll for review and supporting payroll administration
- Maintaining accurate and organised financial records
- Posting journals and preparing month-end reconciliations
- Supporting VAT return preparation
- Assisting with management accounts and supporting schedules
- Maintaining accurate project cost allocations and supporting budget tracking
- Managing compliance processes, including KYC and AML
- Supporting client, sponsor and supplier onboarding
- Assisting with payroll, benefits and wider HR administration
- Helping to improve processes and document finance procedures

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is reliable, commercially minded and confident managing the day-to-day responsibilities of a busy finance function.

You'll ideally have:
- AAT qualification, studying towards AAT, or equivalent bookkeeping experience
- Previous experience in day-to-day bookkeeping, ideally within an SME
- Good working knowledge of Xero
- Experience with multi-currency transactions and reconciliations
- Strong Excel skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to manage your workload independently and meet deadlines

Experience with payroll, international invoicing, EU VAT, professional services, events, media or project accounting would be advantageous.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a small, collaborative and internationally focused business where you'll have genuine ownership of your work and exposure across finance, compliance and wider business operations.

You'll benefit from:
- Hybrid working in Cardiff
- Competitive salary based on experience
- Pension contribution scheme
- 25 days annual leave + public holidays
- Training and support from an experienced Financial Controller
- A broad role with scope to develop your finance career

If you're an AAT-qualified, AAT-studying or experienced finance professional looking for a varied role where no two days are quite the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to find out more.

As a business services organisation based in Cardiff.Our client is a well-established international organisation that delivers specialist services to governments, public sector bodies, and global businesses across Europe. - Process invoices and payments accurately and on time.

- Assist with preparing financial reports and management accounts.

Profile

- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to learn.

Job Offer
- Salary of £30,000
- Yearly bonus.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Private health care.
- Potential study support.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist

Blue Legal is partnering with a leading UK law firm to recruit a Receptionist to join its Front of House team in Cardiff. The successful candidate will provide a professional and welcoming service to clients and visitors, while supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the firm's reception and client meeting areas.

Working hours are 8:00am to 6:00pm, Monday to Friday with an hour for lunch and there is a competitive benefits package on offer.

The Responsibilities:
- Welcome clients, guests and visitors to the office, providing a professional, friendly and efficient front-of-house service.
- Notify relevant colleagues of client and visitor arrivals, ensuring guests are looked after throughout their time at the office.
- Arrange and serve refreshments for client meetings, events and other functions as required.
- Manage bookings for client meeting rooms, ensuring spaces are organised and prepared appropriately.
- Maintain reception and client-facing areas to a high standard, ensuring they remain professional and presentable throughout the day.
- Support the Business Development and Marketing team with the organisation and delivery of on-site client events.
- Provide additional Front of House support as required, including occasional out-of-hours event assistance.

The Candidate:
- Previous receptionist experience, ideally within a legal or professional services environment, with a strong understanding of delivering excellent client service.
- Professional and confident with excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to create a positive first impression.
- Highly organised and customer-focused, with events experience advantageous and flexibility to support occasional out-of-hours functions.

title: Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator
description:
Job Title: Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator

Location: Cardiff, South Wales

Salary/Benefits: 26k - 32k + Training & Benefits

A UKAS accredited asbestos consultancy is recruiting for a detail-oriented Asbestos Report Checker / Administrator. They are ideally seeking someone within a commutable distance to their office in South Wales, but hybrid / home working is a possibility for the right candidate. It is essential that applicants hold the BOHS P402 or RSPH equivalent. This role would suit someone who would like to transition from site work and utilise their hands-on experience to quality check survey reports. Our client is a respected, indpendent outfit who can offer competitive salaries and benefits packages for the successful candidate.

We can consider candidates from the following locations: Cardiff, Barry, Penarth, Caerphilly, Bridgend, Porthcawl, Blackwood, Pontypridd, Tonypandy, Merthyr Tydfil, Pontypool, Risca, Abergavenny, Chepstow, Cwmbran, Magor, Lydney, Barry, Rhoose, Neath, Swansea, Cinderford, Ross-on-Wye, Filton, Yate, Thornbury, Portishead, Severn Beach.

Experience / Qualifications:
- Experience of quality checking / amending Asbestos Survey reports
- Will hold the BOHS P402 or RSPH equivalent
- Excellent technical knowledge, including: HSG 264 and UKAS guidelines
- Strong literacy, numeracy and IT skills
- Able to manage own workload efficiently
- Experience with administrative tasks within an Asbestos outfit

The Role:
- Receiving Asbestos Survey reports in from site staff
- Proof-reading reports to ensure compliance and cohesion
- Making appropriate amendments to reports
- Working closely with Asbestos Surveyors to discuss report contents and highlight errors
- Using CAD software to produce detailed schematic drawings
- Answering incoming contact from clients
- Working to agreed deadlines
- Maintaining own personal technical knowledge

Alternative job titles: Asbestos QC Checker, Asbestos Administrator, Quality Assurance Administrator.

Future Select are the leading market supplier for recruitment in the Asbestos industry; we work with the best clients and candidates and supply the majority of permanent jobs in the asbestos market. We have a large dedicated team, with over 25 years combined industry experience within Asbestos recruitment specifically geared to dealing with Asbestos Surveyors/Analysts/Lab Technicians, Administrators, Project/Regional /Technical/Quality/Training/Sales Managers through to Director Level for both Consultancy & Removal. We have intrinsic knowledge of the market place, as well as respecting candidates/clients confidentiality in this close knit market sector.

We are also interested in anyone with p 401/p 402/p 403/p 404/p 404 or s 301 CCP.

description:

title: Training Course Coordinator
description:
Training Course Coordinator

Location: Hybrid, 1 day per week from home Based from the Cardiff office CF15 7 QZ
Salary: £26,395 per annum
Contract Type: Permanent, full time
What We Can Offer You: 25 Days Annual Leave (Pro-Rata for Part-time and Fixed-Term Roles), Additional Holiday Purchase, Hybrid Working, Performance-Related Bonus, Life Assurance, Vitality Private Healthcare, Subsidised Gym Memberships, Cycle to Work scheme, Discount Vouchers and Access to Wellbeing Resources

Why do we want you

Astutis (part of Wilmington plc) is looking for a highly organised, people-focused individual who loves delivering great service and keeping everything running smoothly.

Working within our Operations Team, you ll look after a caseload of clients and learners, supporting them from the moment a course is booked right through to exams and certification.

You ll coordinate our virtual, classroom and in-company Health, Safety and Environmental courses, handling everything from learner registrations and course materials to customer communications, reporting and exam support.

You ll need a great eye for detail, strong communication skills and a proactive approach to solving problems, while working closely with our Sales and Operations teams to give every client and learner a brilliant experience.

Please note: To complete your application, you will be redirected to Wilmington plc s career site.

At Wilmington plc, we celebrate individuality and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. As a Disability Confident employer, we shortlist all applicants who meet the essential role criteria and guarantee an interview for candidates with disabilities who meet these criteria. For reasonable adjustments or to apply under our interview guarantee scheme, please use the contact details provided once you have clicked apply !

You ll be Responsible For:
- Be the go-to person for your clients and learners, supporting them from course booking right through to exams and certification.
- Keep courses running smoothly by managing confirmations, learner registrations, course materials, attendance records and feedback.
- Make sure learner information is accurate and up to date, including registrations with awarding bodies such as NEBOSH, IOSH and IEMA.
- Build great relationships with clients and work closely with our Sales Account Managers to provide progress updates, reports and a seamless customer experience.
- Keep an eye on learner progress and step in with extra support when needed, including study tools, extensions and resits.
- Stay on top of deadlines, SLAs and KPIs, using our systems and technology to keep everything organised and accurate.
- Work closely with the wider Operations team to share ideas, improve the way we do things and lend a hand when things get busy.

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Knowledge of relevant computer systems including administrative systems, CRM, MS Teams and MS Office packages.
- Solid understanding and knowledge of customer service principles and standards.
- Knowledge of principles and practices of Sales, and how this relates to after-sales customer support and care.
- Excellent understanding and working knowledge of all Microsoft packages
- Excellent word-processing skills
- Attention to detail, including accuracy of information recording, data entry, and communication clarity across all processes, systems and planning tools.

It would be great if you had:
- Previous experience working in a training company.
- General understanding of relevant training certifications and governing bodies including NEBOSH and IOSH advantageous.

What's the Best Thing About This Role

You ll make a real difference to learners, supporting them throughout their training journey while building great relationships along the way. It s varied, people-focused and you ll see the impact of your work every day.

What s the Most Challenging Thing About This Role

There can be a lot of plates spinning at once, with multiple courses, deadlines and customer requests to manage. You ll need to stay organised, keep an eye on the details and be comfortable juggling priorities when things get busy.

We know it s not a skill, but the successful candidate must have permission to work in the role s location by the start of their employment.

Before you go

About us

Astutis is a market leader in workplace health, safety, and environmental training, helping organisations create safer, healthier work environments. As part of Wilmington plc, we are committed to delivering high-quality courses and outstanding customer service.

Join us and do Work That Means Something

At Wilmington plc, we help global customers to do the right business in the right way - providing trusted data, insights, and education to navigate the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) landscape.

When you join us, you ll not only make a real difference for our customers, you ll also enjoy flexibility through hybrid working and benefit from a wide range of learning, career, and development opportunities.

Whether you're just starting out, returning to work after a break, or looking to take your next step, you ll be doing work with meaning.

Join us and make a real difference. Click on APPLY today!

title: Team Coordinator
description:
Dedicated to sustainable development, Arup is a collective of designers, consultants and experts working globally.

At Arup you will have the opportunity to collaborate on ambitious projects - delivering remarkable outcomes for clients and communities, and to do socially useful work that has meaning.

Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set it apart for over 75 years, and now is your opportunity to join.

AMS is a global workforce solutions partner committed to creating inclusive, dynamic, and future-ready workplaces. We help organisations adapt, grow, and thrive in an ever-evolving world by building, shaping, and optimising diverse talent strategies.

We partner with Arup to support their contingent recruitment processes. Acting as an extension of their recruitment teams, we connect them with skilled interim and temporary professionals, fostering workplaces where everyone can contribute and succeed.

On Behalf of Arup, we are looking for a Team Coordinator for a 6 month contract based in Cardiff. Hybrid, with 3 days per week required on-site.

Purpose of the role

We're looking for an experienced Team Coordinator to join Arup and provide day-to-day coordination and administrative support across the Property Science Industry portfolio.

You'll play a key role in keeping the team organised and running effectively, supporting operational and project activity, producing high-quality documents and presentations, coordinating stakeholders and events, and assisting with bids and wider business development activity.

What you'll do
- Coordinate day-to-day team activities, meetings, diaries and schedules.
- Produce and edit high-quality documents, reports and presentations in line with Arup branding.
- Proofread and improve written content for clarity, consistency and professional presentation.
- Support bids, PQQs and work-winning activity, including preparing CVs and project sheets.
- Support project teams with administrative and operational requirements.
- Coordinate holidays, absences, wellbeing requirements and team records.
- Support new starters through onboarding and induction.
- Organise internal social events and client events.
- Create and maintain trackers, including training records.
- Book meeting rooms and coordinate audiovisual equipment, refreshments and other meeting requirements.
- Support and communicate with multiple stakeholders across the wider business.

The Skills you'll need
- Strong experience within a Team Coordinator, Executive Assistant, Project Coordinator, Office Coordinator or similar administrative role.
- Excellent Microsoft 365 skills, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, SharePoint and ideally Copilot.
- Strong PowerPoint and document-production skills, with the ability to create professional, client-facing materials.
- Strong organisation and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Experience coordinating meetings, diaries, stakeholders and team activities.
- Experience supporting bids, PQQs or business development activity would be advantageous.
- Previous experience within professional services, consultancy, engineering, architecture or a similar environment would be beneficial.
- An NVQ or similar administration/secretarial qualification would be desirable but is not essential.

Why Arup

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. Guided by its values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, Arup creates and contributes to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all.

Arup's internal employee networks support their inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion - creating a space for everyone to express themselves and make a positive difference.

title: Receptionist/Care Navigator
description: We are seeking a friendly, proactive, and highly organised Care Navigator to join our supportive team across Birchgrove Surgery and Rhiwbina Branch Surgery. As a key first point of contact for our patients, you will play a vital role in helping them access the right care at the right time and ensuring the smooth running of our busy GP practices. The position is 25 hours Monday Friday 8am - 1pm. Provide a warm, professional welcome to all patients and visitors Manage incoming calls, appointment bookings, and patient queries Signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional or service Support the clinical team with administrative tasks Update and maintain accurate patient records Assist in promoting self-care, digital tools, and community resources Work flexibly across both surgery sites as needed Answering high volume calls from our patients, in an efficient and courteous manner, putting patients at ease and providing clear concise information. Take clear and concise notes of patient interactions ensuring these documented accurately in EMIS WEB clinical software tool. After appropriate training, triage patient calls using a variety of questioning techniques in order to develop a full picture of the nature of the patients problem and signpost the patient to the appropriate care. Identify potentially serious problems and bring those to the immediate attention of the correct clinician; i.e. on call GP; Minor Illness Nurse, etc. For less serious problems signpost the patient and identify an appropriate timeframe for them to be seen, and the appropriate person to see them. Build and maintain strong relationships with all staff. Developing and maintaining an in-depth knowledge and understanding of the services provided in the practice and in the wider health community; be able to use this knowledge to guide the patient to the service, which is most likely to meet their needs, whether inside or outside the practice. Deal appropriately with instructions and queries from clinicians and outside agencies. Cover the reception desk to deal with patient enquiries face to face. Following practice standard operating procedures. Maintain strict confidentiality in relation to all issues concerned within the service and adhere to the requirements of the Data Protection Act 1984, Information Governance and Caldicott Principles.
